brief: Today we celebrate Peter and his confession of faith, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.” Peter, the impulsive and rash, trying and failing to walk on the water; denying his master before the crucifixion, yet risking imprisonment and death after Pentecost; baptising the Roman centurion Cornelius, yet failing in charity to Gentile Christians at Antioch and being rebuked by Paul. The tradition of his martyrdom in Rome is early, and the site of his burial under St Peter’s is highly probable.
